app[content][earlyaccess][why]: As an independent development team, genuine feedback from the community is essential for refining the game. Listening to player voices will help us shape future content and build a game everyone can truly enjoy.
app[content][earlyaccess][how_long]: We estimate the Early Access phase will last approximately 12 months. However, this is not a strict deadline; the exact duration will depend on player feedback and the time required to polish the game.
app[content][earlyaccess][full_version]: For the full version, we plan to expand the world, introduce new interactive mechanics, and add richer visual feedback. Additionally, we will polish the UI, optimize performance, and integrate Steam Achievements, pseudo-multiplayer systems, and Workshop support to deliver deeper replayability and custom content.
app[content][earlyaccess][current_state]: The current Early Access version already includes the core gameplay loop. Players can experience a full town, key mechanics, enemy types, and the foundational art style. While fully playable, there may still be undiscovered bugs, and the difficulty curve and visual polish are actively being refined.
app[content][earlyaccess][pricing]: Yes. To thank early supporters who help us refine the game, the Early Access version is available at a lower price. As development progresses and new content is added, we plan to slightly increase the price upon the 1.0 full release.
app[content][earlyaccess][community]: We will use the Steam Community Discussions as our primary hub for collecting player feedback, bug reports, and ideas. Our website and in-game menu also feature direct feedback options. Player suggestions directly influence our development priorities for upcoming updates.
app[content][about]:
[p][/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]As fans of Hideo Kojima, we made a game about delivering cargo at the end of the world.[/b][/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/title"][/img][/p][p]Sponge Bridges is a delivery-focused post-apocalyptic survival game paying homage to Death Stranding and Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead.[/p][p]The Red Mist has swallowed everything. A handful of survivors are scattered among the ruins, cut off from one another.[/p][p][b]You are a courier. The cargo on your back is the only thing still connecting them.[/b][/p][p]And somewhere beyond the Red Mist seems to lie the source of the apocalypse.[/p][p]Find it, and perhaps you can save this world.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]01 — Minimalist Style, Deep Character Creation[/b][/h2][p]
From your appearance and body to character traits that genuinely affect survival.[/p][p][b]Before you step into the Red Mist, decide who you want to be.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]02 — Reconnect a Broken World[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Cargo is not just a number in your inventory.[/b][/p][p]It may decide whether an entire city is destroyed by a nuclear strike.[/p][p][/p][p]So, one piece after another—[/p][p][b]keep stacking it higher.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]03 — Staying Alive Is a Problem in Itself[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Hunger is not just a countdown bar.[/b][/p][p][b]Getting hurt is not just losing a few HP.[/b][/p][p]An insignificant-looking wound may eventually kill you.[/p][p]
[b]Things in the world are not merely decoration, either.[/b][/p][p]Take them apart, gather materials, and turn those materials into what you actually need.[/p][p]
[b]04 — Kill Them, or Let Them Go?[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Shooting is not your only option.[/b][/p][p]They can stop. Eat. Then leave.[/p][p][/p][p]Or—[/p][p][b]kill them all.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2][b]05 — This Is an Entire Post-Apocalyptic World[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]3,000+ items and crafting recipes[/b][/p][p]A huge variety of monsters · terrain · furniture · buildings[/p][p][/p][p]A seeded world of roughly [b]47 million tiles[/b], linked together into a vast network of cities.[/p][p]Enter buildings, climb onto rooftops, descend underground, and dismantle, combine, and make use of whatever you find.[/p][p]
[/p][p]In the end, all these numbers mean only one thing:[/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]The same problem never has only one solution.[/b][/h2]
app[content][short_description]: G-City has fallen. Survivors are hiding in scattered corners of the city, and food, and everyday supplies are scarce. You make a living delivering cargo for others—and, along the way, try to find out what happened here. For now... just get the cargo delivered. And try not to starve on the way.
